item.description:
Roy Amery & Mick Tahan from R&W Elite Group are proud to present this rare opportunity in Orchard Hills with a huge 5 acres (2.032 hectares) (RU4 Primary Production Zoning) opportunities like these don't come often and located in the Western Sydney Growth Corridor within close distance to the new Orchard Hills Metro Train Station, St Marys train station (metro) and Western Sydney Airport with easy access to major arterial roads including M4 / M7 and Great Western Highway. This is a rare opportunity for developers, investors or landbank and hold for future capital appreciation.

Featuring:
* 2.032 hectares (5 Acres) Landholding
* Zoned RU4 Primary Production
* Only 1.2km to the Orchard Hills Sydney Metro train station and upcoming town centre (opening soon)
* Easy access to major roads including M4 / M7 Motorways and Great Western Highway
* Close to Nepean Hospital, University of Western Sydney and Penrith CBD
* Close to the newly built Western Sydney Aerotropolis and Bradfield City Centre
* Only minutes away from Caddens Corner Shopping Centre and Restaurants Precinct

Please call Roy Amery or Mick Tahan from R&W Elite Group on 0414 672 497 for more information.
